title: Fried clams
venue: the Newport college paper / the laundromat digest
logline: Daumier didn't need a cohort. Gully has clams.

panels.composition: The frame shop backroom. WOOD cutting mat board with a dull utility knife, a monologue balloon bubbling over the panel border.

characters.pose: bent over a mat cutter, knife mid-stroke

balloons.text: Daumier didn't need a four-year cohort in an air-conditioned loft. Melville didn't get an MFA.

image.prompt: a thin young man in a chore coat cutting mat board with a utility knife in a cluttered picture-framing backroom, frames stacked against the wall, harsh xerox contrast, frantic vertical hatching
image.notes: Let the balloon break the panel border.

panels.composition: GULLY leans through the shop's side door holding two wax-paper grease sacks. Rain behind him.

characters.pose: leaning in through a door, two grease sacks held up

balloons.text: Got fried clams from the docks. They're mostly rubber, but the tartar sauce is aggressive.

image.prompt: a stocky young man in a backwards cap leaning in through a shop side door holding up two grease-stained paper sacks, rain hatching behind him

panels.composition: Wood stares at him, mid-knife-stroke, utterly dead-eyed.

image.prompt: close-up of a young man frozen mid-cut with a utility knife, staring dead-eyed at someone off-panel, heavy black spotting

panels.composition: Silent wide shot. Both of them on upturned five-gallon spackle buckets in the rain alley behind the shop, chewing fried clams in total silence.

characters.pose: sitting on a bucket, chewing, sack in lap
sitting on a bucket, chewing, content

image.prompt: wide silent shot of two young men sitting on upturned spackle buckets in a narrow rain alley behind a shop, eating from paper sacks, cold coastal rain rendered as frantic vertical hatching

notes: The Arthur-and-Gully beat, canonical form: eight sentences, one reply, silence.
